stem: Fluorine-18 (¹⁸₉F) decays by beta-plus (β⁺) emission with a half-life of 110 minutes.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State the name of the beta-plus particle.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the decay constant of fluorine-18 is 1.05 × 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the activity of 2.1 × 10⁻¹² kg of fluorine-18.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead: A small sample of fluorine-18 injected into the body acts as a tracer for use in medical imaging.
parts.text: Describe how the interaction of a β⁺ particle with an electron in the body enables the formation of an image.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest why 110 minutes is a suitable half-life for a nuclide used as a tracer in medical diagnosis.
